name: expense-tracker-api-sdk
description: A REST API for company expense claims. Employees record expenses and group them into claims. Approvers approve or reject claims. Finance maintains categories and marks approved claims as reimbursed.  **Three entities:** Category, Expense, Claim **Reporting currency:** EUR (all monetary values exact to 2 decimal places) **Authentication:** JWT bearer token with role-based access (employee, approver, finance)  **Status transitions for claims:** draft → submitted → approved/rejected → reimbursed  **Key rules:** - Expenses must have receipts when amount exceeds category threshold - Claims require at least one expense to submit - Expenses can belong to only one claim - Date incurred must not be in the future - Expenses older than 90 days cannot be added to claims

scripts.build: tsup-node src/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts --clean && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');function fx(s,d){const dir=path.dirname(s);const c=fs.readFileSync(s,'utf8');const p=c.replace(/((?:from|import)\s*\(?\s*[\x27\x22])(\.\.?\/[^\x27\x22]+?)([\x27\x22])/g,(m,a,b,e)=>{if(/\.[a-zA-Z0-9]+$/.test(b))return m;const suffix=fs.existsSync(path.join(dir,b)+'.d.ts')?'.js':'/index.js';return a+b+suffix+e});fs.writeFileSync(d,p)};fx('dist/index.d.ts','dist/index.d.mts')"
